Internal notes / ask for legal triage:

Kimberly — quick priorities for the MSA redline and order form:
- Commercial cap: request limit of liability cap = $5,000,000 (subject to review by finance)
- IP: standard ownership clause — Brightlane owns customer data, Redwood retains model improvements (we should preserve this carveout)
- Data residency: they listed US primary; confirm no EU residency requirement before agreeing to restrictions
- SLA/credits: ask for 99.9% baseline with an escalation path; we should avoid unlimited credits in early stages
- Termination for convenience: propose 60 days with obligation to pay for outstanding committed seats

Security asks for Elena: SOC 2 Type II (past 12 months), encryption at-rest details, a contact for penetration test reports (if available). We can provide our SOC 2 and a standard security questionnaire once they confirm PHI scope.

Timeline (internal target):
- Legal redline pass: by EOD 2026-09-20
- Commercial review + proposed concessions: 2026-09-21
- Sign-off / send to Elena for counter by 2026-09-22

I uploaded a short redline-priority-checklist (attached) that legal can use to mark clauses that require commercial sign-off.
